policy.tested: The exact component tuple completed a bounded local benchmark.
policy.probe_only: Presence or import was observed, but the complete modelling route was not exercised.
policy.unknown: No compatibility claim; unknown never means unsupported.
policy.incompatible: A concrete incompatibility was reproduced for the exact tuple only.
